title: Page 10
content_zh:
「除了准备，我们没别的事情好做了吗？」他不想手勾手伤心。
「嗄？」她没听懂。
他说了，「所有的检查通通做完了。」
「对，早上抽完最后一次血了。」
「你要到晚上九点才开始禁食。」
她点头。「护士小姐是这样交代的。」
「我们还有十二个小时，为什么不好好利用？」交代后事、愁容相对，都不是最好的方式。
「利用？」在医院里面？她不懂。
「我们出去玩吧，吃好吃、看好看、玩好玩的，今天我当你的眼睛，带你领略台北风情。」
就这样，他们向医院请假，在不知道明天存不存在的时候，把握起最后。
他们去北投泡温泉、去金山吃芋圆、去饶河夜市喝药炖排骨、去百货公司买漂亮洋装。他们玩得很累，晚上，两个人双双躺在单人病床上时，她问：「明天，我可不可以穿我的新洋装进手术房？」
隔天，是雨天，诸事不顺。
从一大早，商天雨的点滴就漏了，她的体温偏高、没事哭了起来，哭得蒋誉一团乱。
她莫名暴躁、莫名发飙，莫名地为难蒋誉，而且直到她被推进手术室前，她父亲都没赶到医院。
九点半，她进开刀房，蒋誉的眼皮跳得很厉害，握住她的手心不断出汗，恐惧在心底蔓延。
百花盛开，墓园旁的鸡蛋花开出亮眼金黄，红的、橘的、粉的九重葛争相竞艳，美丽的春天一如墓碑上女孩的美丽笑脸。
蒋誉一袭深黑色西装，白色衬衫结上紫色领带。紫色，是女孩最喜欢的颜色。
他捧着一大把长茎玫瑰，九百九十九朵，是花店小姐推荐的，说九百九十九朵玫瑰代表天长地久。
这是很好的推荐，因为他们的爱情静止于若干年前，停在不变的永恒点，他没忘记她的笑颜，而她，除了他，再不会爱上别人。
不褪色的爱情、不改变的情人，是不是符合了天长地久的条件？

「嗨，你在那边过得好吗？」他问，语调里有淡淡的哀愁。
然而他发现，原来时间会把浓烈的哀愁转淡，让胸口的疼痛不再深郁。
「我听过一个论调，是公司里面的员工告诉我的，他说，天堂里有喝不尽的琼浆玉液，酒后驾车也不会收到红单，真的吗？那么，在那边开PUB一定会倒闭。」
讲到最后，他轻轻笑开。果然是奸商啊，走到哪里都不忘记能够做什么生意。
「除了PUB，交通警察和计程车都会没事干，那他们在那里，日子那么漫长，要做什么？你一定要说，在天堂里什么都不必做，只要每天开开心心唱歌跳舞就可以……唉，我开始担心了，像我这种劳碌命，是不是登不上天国的天梯？」
他把玫瑰花束拆开，将玫瑰花一朵朵插在坟上上，种满韩国草的绿色坟墓，点缀起点点鲜红，热闹精彩。
「有个问题一直困扰着我，我想知道，是不是住进天堂就会无忧无虑，没有哀愁的人生是不是会比较惬意？」他顿了顿，接话。「你要说我笨了对不？这么简单的问题干么问，答案就是一整个对，不必怀疑。可是最近我发现，有忧郁不是坏事……」
一颗雨水落下，阻止他的话。
蒋誉仰头，厚厚的云盖满天际，天空阴了两日，闷得人发慌，好不容易下雨，感觉舒服多了。
雨下大，但绵绵密密，像丝，凉凉的雨水贴在脸颊边，带着冰凉的清爽宜人。
跳跳最讨厌雨天，老说自己的命很坏、泪水叮叮咚咚掉不完，就是名字里带了太多水，可偏偏又爱淋雨。
那时他嘲笑她。「你以为自己是绛珠草投胎的林黛玉哦，你哪有泪水叮叮咚咚掉不完？」
她噘嘴不依。「我都哭在你看不到的地方。」
对，他没忘记，她是越伤心就要笑得越阳光的跳跳，舍不得啊，舍不得她总是在他看不见的地方哭泣。
他的跳跳，他对她的爱一天比一天增加……
开刀前，他们约好要做很多事，跳跳说：「等我眼睛看得见了，我要回到舞台上面。」
他同意了，交代下面的员工找资料，规划出成立舞团的要点。
跳跳说：「我想开舞蹈教室，教小朋友跳舞，把小朋友带到国际上，让大家看看，台湾小孩也很棒。」
他说没问题，然后放出讯息，要朋友帮忙找地。
跳跳说：「如果我的病好了，我就要跟阿誉求婚，我会送阿誉又大又亮的钻石戒指，阿誉一定要答应娶我哦！」

他大笑。「通常，我不会让女人失望。」
他说谎，他通常都让女人失望，这辈子，他只没让两个女人失望，一个是晴天，一个跳跳。
但约定的事，他们都没做，舞团没成立、教室没开，跳跳也没向他求婚，但他不火大，因为他从来就没本事对她发脾气。
雨下得更大了，他的黑色头发垂到额前，闪闪的雨滴在他的睫毛上挂了雨帘，有点狼狈，却也有着浪漫的凄美。
窸窸窣窣，身后传来声响，他回头。
远处，一个穿着蓝色小洋装的女人撑起一把蓝色小雨伞，细细的小腿沾上车地上的水珠子，她也抱着一把红玫瑰，轻轻巧巧地向前走来。
他曾经和跳跳约定，如果看见这样一个女人，如果他心动了，就要努力追求。
说到做到！他的商誉一向很好。
蒋誉拉起嘴角，展开温柔笑脸，朝蓝衣女孩走去。
「对不起，我迟到了。」
伞下的女孩仰起头，甜甜的脸挂上微笑，那是跳跳，和他做过许多约定的女孩，她恢复了健康，重拾了梦想。
现在回过头想想，当时实在好大胆，居然敢把赌注下得这么大，但也幸好下了，因为到最后，他们是赢家。
「没关系，我可以先和晴天说悄悄话。」
「没说我的坏话吧？」
「不敢。」
「厚，这么可怜哦，讲得好像我很凶。」
「我不敢说你的坏话，是因为晴天爱记恨，她会把我的话一笔一笔记下来，等我上天堂后，再来个秋后算总帐。」
商天雨笑开眉，伸出手，和他十指相扣。
一把小小的伞撑住了他宽宽的肩膀，雨丝不停飞跃进来，他不怕，她也喜欢。
雨天，是她的天气呢，有阿誉这个超好运男人在，会替她挡去所有不幸。

「你告诉妈妈和姊姊，我们要结婚了吗？」妈妈的骨灰迁葬了，是阿誉一手包办的。
「有，她们要我们把喜帖送到这里，她们想分享喜悦。」
「你告诉她们，我会在婚礼上跳姊姊的成名曲——橱窗娃娃吗？」
「说了，晴天你要好好表现，不可以丢她的脸。」
「你有告诉她们，我会把『晴天』生出来吗？」
他继续点头。「有，她说要你认真生，不要太随便，最好生漂亮一点、聪明一点、可爱一点，然后在送女儿去学跳舞的时候，把晴天小时候的舞衣送给『小小晴天』当见面礼。」
「我就说吧，妈妈和姊姊对我最好了。」她骄傲的咧！
「不是只有妈妈姊姊对你好吧？」他用大拇指指了指自己。
「了解了解，阿誉对我更是好上加好。」
两个人，相视而笑。
他们一起走到商天晴和商母的坟前，商天雨才插上玫瑰，满肚子的话就叽哩咕噜滚出来说个没完。
「姊，我去看礼服了耶！老爸说要出钱，既然他要出钱，我哪有客气的份，当然要挑最贵的，我挑了件象牙白的，是姊姊最喜欢的颜色，姊姊来不及穿的，跳跳帮你穿……」
content_en:
"Besides preparation, don't we have anything else to do?" He didn't want to hold hands and feel sad.
"Huh?" She didn't understand.
He said, "All inspections have been completed."
"Yes, I finished the last blood draw this morning."
"You don't start fasting until nine o'clock in the evening."
She nodded. "That's what the nurse said."
"We still have twelve hours, why not make good use of it?" It is not the best way to explain the funeral and look at each other with sad faces.
"Use?" In the hospital? She doesn't understand.
"Let's go out and have fun. Eat delicious food, see beautiful things, and have fun. Today I will be your eyes and show you the Taipei style."
In this way, they asked for leave from the hospital, seizing the last moment when they didn't know whether tomorrow would exist.
They went to Beitou to soak in hot springs, to Jinshan to eat taro balls, to Raohe Night Market to drink medicinal braised pork ribs, and to department stores to buy beautiful dresses. They were very tired from playing. At night, when they were both lying on a single hospital bed, she asked, "Can I wear my new dress into the operating room tomorrow?"
The next day, it was rainy and everything went wrong.
Shang Tianyu's drip had been leaking since early in the morning. Her body temperature was high and she started crying, which made Jiang Yu a mess.
She was inexplicably irritable and furious, making things difficult for Jiang Yu. Moreover, her father did not arrive at the hospital until she was pushed into the operating room.
At nine-thirty, she entered the surgery room. Jiang Yu's eyelids were twitching violently, the palms of her hands were sweating, and fear spread in his heart.
Flowers are in full bloom, the frangipani next to the cemetery is blooming in bright golden color, and the red, orange and pink bougainvillea are competing for beauty. The beautiful spring is just like the beautiful smiling face of the girl on the tombstone.
Jiang Yu wore a dark black suit, a white shirt and a purple tie. Purple is girls' favorite color.
He was holding a large handful of long-stemmed roses, nine hundred and ninety-nine, recommended by the florist lady, who said that nine hundred and ninety-nine roses represented eternity.
This is a good recommendation, because their love stopped several years ago and stopped at the same eternal point. He has not forgotten her smile, and she will never fall in love with anyone else except him.
Does the love that never fades and the lover that never changes meet the conditions of everlasting life?
"Hi, how are you doing there?" he asked, with a touch of sadness in his tone.
However, he discovered that time would soften the intense sadness and make the pain in his chest no longer deep.
"I heard an argument that was told to me by an employee in the company. He said that there is endless wine in heaven, and you will not get a red ticket for driving under the influence. Is it true? Then, if you open a PUB there, it will definitely go bankrupt."
At the end of the story, he smiled softly. He is indeed a profiteer. Wherever he goes, he never forgets what kind of business he can do.
"Besides PUB, the traffic police and taxis will have nothing to do, so what are they going to do when the days are so long? You must say that you don't have to do anything in heaven, just sing and dance happily every day... Oh, I'm starting to worry, will I not be able to climb the ladder to heaven with a hard life like mine?"
He opened the bouquet of roses and inserted them one by one on the grave. The green grave filled with Korean grass was decorated with bright red dots, making it lively and exciting.
"There is a question that has been bothering me. I want to know if living in heaven will make me carefree. Would a life without sorrow be more comfortable?" He paused and continued. "You want to say that I'm stupid, right? Why ask such a simple question? The answer is absolutely right, no need to doubt it. But recently I discovered that being depressed is not a bad thing..."
A raindrop fell, stopping his words.
Jiang Yu raised his head, and saw thick clouds covering the sky. The sky had been overcast for two days, making people panic. It finally rained, and he felt much better.
The rain was heavy, but it was dense and silky, and the cool rain clung to the cheeks, bringing a cool and refreshing feeling.
jump jumpI hate rainy days the most. I always say that my life is very bad and I can’t stop crying. It’s just that my name contains too much water, but I love getting wet in the rain.
He laughed at her then. "You think you are Lin Daiyu reincarnated by Jiangzhucao, how can you never stop crying?"
She pouted. "I'm crying where you can't see me."
Yes, he has not forgotten that the sadder she is, the brighter and brighter she will smile. He can't bear to let her go. He can't bear to let her cry where he can't see her.
His dancing, his love for her is growing day by day...
Before the surgery, they agreed to do a lot of things. Tiaodiao said, "When I can see again, I will return to the stage."
He agreed and asked the employees below to find information and plan out the key points for establishing a dance troupe.
Tiaodiao said, "I want to open a dance class, teach children to dance, and bring children to the world, so that everyone can see that Taiwanese children are also great."
He said no problem, and then sent out a message asking friends to help find land.
Tiaotiao said: "If my illness is cured, I will propose to Ayu. I will give Ayu a big and bright diamond ring. Ayu must agree to marry me!"
He laughed. "Usually, I don't disappoint women."
He lies, and he usually disappoints women. In this life, he has only disappointed two women, one is Qingtian and the other is Tiaotiao.
But they didn't do what they agreed to do. The dance troupe was not established, the classroom was not open, and Tiaodiao did not propose to him. But he was not angry because he had never been able to lose his temper with her.
The rain was falling harder. His black hair hung down to his forehead, and the sparkling raindrops hung rain curtains on his eyelashes. He looked a little embarrassed, but also had a romantic poignancy.
There was a rustling sound behind him, and he turned around.
In the distance, a woman in a blue dress held up a small blue umbrella, her thin calves stained with water drops on the ground. She also held a handful of red roses and walked forward gently and deftly.
He once agreed with Tiaotiao that if he saw such a woman and his heart moved, he would work hard to pursue her.
no sooner said than done! His goodwill has always been good.
Jiang Yu raised the corners of his mouth, spread a gentle smile, and walked towards the girl in blue.
"Sorry, I'm late."
The girl under the umbrella raised her head, with a smile on her sweet face. She was Tiao Tiao, the girl who had made many promises with him. She had recovered her health and regained her dream.
Thinking back now, I was so bold at the time that I dared to place such a big bet, but luckily I did because in the end, they were the winners.
"It doesn't matter, I can whisper to Qingtian first."
"You didn't say anything bad about me, did you?"
"Don't dare."
"Hou, you're so pitiful. You talk like I'm cruel."
"I dare not speak ill of you because Qingtian loves to hold grudges. She will write down my words one by one. After I go to heaven, I will settle the accounts again."
Shang Tianyu smiled, stretched out his hand, and interlocked his fingers.
A small umbrella supported his broad shoulders, and raindrops kept flying in. He was not afraid, and she liked it too.
Rainy days are her kind of weather. With Ayu, a super lucky man, he will ward off all misfortunes for her.
"Are you telling mom and sister that we are getting married?" Mom's ashes were moved and buried, and it was Ayu who arranged it all.
"Yes, they asked us to send the wedding invitations here. They want to share the joy."
"Do you tell them that I will dance to my sister's famous song - Window Dolls at the wedding?"
"I told you, Qingtian, you have to behave well and don't embarrass her."
"Did you tell them that I would give birth to 'Sunny'?"
He continued to nod. "Yes, she said that she wants you to be serious about giving birth and not be too casual. It is best to give birth to a girl who is beautiful, smart and cute. Then when you send your daughter to learn to dance, give Qingtian's childhood dance clothes to 'little Qingtian' as a meeting gift."
"I'll just tell you, Mom.My sister and I are the best to me. ” She was so proud!
"Mom and sister are not the only ones who treat you well, okay?" He pointed at himself with his thumb.
"I understand, I understand, Ayu is even better to me."
The two people looked at each other and smiled.
They walked together to the graves of Shang Tianqing and Shang's mother. Shang Tianyu just put roses on them and started chattering non-stop when he was full of words.
"Sister, I'm going to look at the dresses! Dad said he would pay for it. Since he wants to pay, I can't be polite. Of course I have to pick the most expensive one. I picked an ivory white one, which is my sister's favorite color. My sister has no time to wear it. I'll help you wear it..."
